Complete character is the difference of exterior-power traces, and subgroup invariants follow via standard symmetric-group representation and rational transfer. A separate exact finite checker verifies signed traces for every element of eight full groups, mod-two boundary ranks, and quotient invariant dimensions.

value.rationale: Determining the canonical integral group-action lattice for an all-parameter natural family refines a known nonequivariant homotopy classification. The size-independent invariant dimension binom(s-1,r) for within-part symmetries and complete rational disappearance under part permutations are motivated quotient-space phenomena that cannot be inferred from the known ordinary Betti numbers. The full character is computable for any graph automorphism and can distinguish actions with identical ranks.
